name: Langfuse
short: Open-source LLM observability and tracing platform with a free Hobby cloud tier (no credit card required).

plans.name: Hobby (Free)
plans.notes: 50,000 units per month, 30 days data access, 2 users, no credit card required. All platform features with limits.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: 100,000 units per month (additional $8/100k), 90 days data access, unlimited users, in-app support.
